title: Yolk–shell SnSe2@NC nanocubes: synergistic interior void and spatial confinement for superior sodium-ion battery anodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6043-6049
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00119F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanan Du, Zhilong Wu, Siying Wang, Ran Sun, Zhiya Lin, Hai Jia, Xiaohui Huang, Shaoming Ying, Zhiqiang Huang
We illustrate the yolk–shell structure of SnSe2@NC, highlighting its robust architecture for stable sodium storage. At a high current density of 5 A g−1, it delivers an impressive capacity, demonstrating its superior performance as an SIB anode.
